title: Dispersion
definition: Dispersion is the phenomenon of splitting of white light into its constituent colors (spectrum) when passing through a dispersive medium like a prism, caused by the variation of refractive index with wavelength.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding optical phenomena, atmospheric science (rainbows, sky color), and advanced communication technologies (fiber optics).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Dispersion.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
